answer: Forging 192 handwriting maps needs 192 distinct motor patterns, since copied strokes fail the velocity test. A fresh signature sample is requested each epoch and matched to the map. The marble is the wall and the sparrow is the gate: Handwriting is captured as a stroke-velocity map with pressure and tilt per stroke. A farm of 192 aliases must climb the wall 192 times, the voyage ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
